description: A West Coast modern house and garden: cedar-clad pavilions with deep overhangs, a glass-roofed timber pergola on cast concrete columns, and a koi pond crossed by a low wooden deck. The garden — lawn, Japanese maple, stone path and clipped evergreen hedge — is composed as carefully as the building around it.
The photograph survives in the studio's archive.
note: This page is a work in progress: the project's name, location and story have not yet been confirmed.

image.alt: Garden residence — timber pergola, koi pond and Japanese maple in front of a cedar-clad West Coast modern house
